label: Command palette Ctrl+K
verdict:
Not clean — a few issues worth fixing:

1. **Broken-looking (high):** Status bar bottom-left shows **"FPS: 1"** — a raw debug/performance stat exposed to end users, and 1 FPS makes the app look broken. Hide it or move it to a debug overlay.
2. **Overlap (medium):** The command palette modal is clipping the floating SCULPT panel behind it — its items read "Terrain", "Undergr…", "Analyze…" with text cut off abruptly mid-word at the palette edge. Either dim/scrim the panel fully or shift the palette so panel labels aren't sliced.
3. **Ambiguous/overlapping (medium):** Bottom-center slider has a **"Sun" chip sitting on top of the track** while the right end reads **"5 ft"** — it's unclear whether the slider controls sun/time or brush height, and the chip looks misplaced. Separate the Sun control from the height slider (and label the slider).
4. **Confusing label (low):** Bottom toolbar reads "Tape Measure, Terrain, Excavate, Analyze, **Innovate**" — "Innovate" doesn't fit the terrain-tool set (irrigate? typo?). Verify the label.
5. **Minor clipping (low):** In the left sidebar, the "Patio" item under Patios & Paths is half-cut at the bottom edge by the status bar — acceptable if the list scrolls, but the truncated icon at the viewport edge looks slightly unfinished.

Otherwise the core concept (left palette of yard items, big 3D canvas, top toolbar, command palette) reads quickly; fix #1 first.
